verdict.rationale: Mem0 offers a broad programmatic surface: a published OpenAPI spec, SDK calls for add and search, a CLI covering add, search, list, update and delete, and account and API-key creation from the terminal with no dashboard needed. That shows many workflows avoid the UI. However, no evidence states that the API matches everything the dashboard does, so this is partial. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement; documented API coverage of dashboard admin functions (project settings, webhook management, audit-log access, export setup); independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.mem0.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Four terminal commands create an account and API key. No email, no dashboard.
The mem0 CLI lets you add, search, list, update, and delete memories directly from the terminal.
Mem0's Platform API lets you separate memories for different users, agents, and apps.
You can configure webhooks to send HTTP POST requests to your specified URLs whenever memories are created, updated, deleted, or categorized.
